name: eternityspring/reelbench-skills
description: A video analysis and reel benchmarking skill collection. The sample skill, video-shots, analyses video shots. Its install script is a local copy installer, not a remote fetcher.
install: git clone, then ./scripts/install.sh (local symlink installer: symlinks skill folders into ~/.claude/skills or ~/.codex/skills, skips existing real directories rather than overwriting them, supports --uninstall), or manual copy (cp -r skills/video-shots ~/.claude/skills/)
